items.html: And behold, there is a place in the lower Garden of Eden where the point of Bina is. And there, close to her, stand those kings who reigned in the land of Edom. And those souls of the righteous who are there are all of the phase of the possessors of the Kav [measure], for they are of this secret of the aforementioned Kav, and therefore they must clothe themselves in those Kabin [measures], and this suffices.
